comment: Independent C-first eat.c:cpostfx entry-point recording. A newly chosen debug Wizard wishes for a human wererat corpse, eats it from the floor, and dismisses the poison page. C names it a wererat corpse and later reports cannibalism, establishing the human-corpse path; cpostfx maps PM_HUMAN_WERERAT to PM_WERERAT, calls set_ulycn, then retouch_equipment(2).
